[지수 함수: : power(밑, 지수)](#246eda9b0fe18000964bea887c71ed95) > - [제곱근 함수: sqrt(target)](#246eda9b0fe1800a9706e1f762a3cb71) > - [로그 함수: log(밑, target)](#246eda9b0fe1809f9e4fdd0f1950419e) > - [로그 함수: ln(target) = log(target) ( 밑: e, 자연상수 )](#246eda9b0fe180ccb8cce64f9273db8b) ### 소수점 자르기 : trunc(target, 소수점 자리수) ```sql # Oracle SELECT trunc(38.888, 2) # 결과: 38.88 ( 소수점 2자리 미만 자름 ) FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80c0-a670-d267d7691821/3360f133cad84cef.webp) ### 삼각함수: sin(), cos(), tan() ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT sin(0), # 결과: 0 cos(0), # 결과: 1 tan(0) # 결과: 0 FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80c0-a670-d267d7691821/6185e1236a88ea96.webp) ### 지수 함수: exp() ( 밑: e, 자연상수 ) ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT exp(2) FROM dual ``` - exp(2): e^2 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80c0-a670-d267d7691821/3dd797ab35f3748b.webp) ### 지수 함수: : power(밑, 지수) ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT power(2, 4) FROM dual ``` - power(2, 4): 2^4 = 16 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80c0-a670-d267d7691821/46b81edf527c892c.webp) ### 제곱근 함수: sqrt(target) ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT sqrt(4) FROM dual ``` - sqrt(4): \sqrt{4} = 2 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80c0-a670-d267d7691821/2ea5303716dd9b36.webp) ### 로그 함수: log(밑, target) ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT log(10, 100) FROM dual ``` - log(10, 100): \log_{10}(100) = 2 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80c0-a670-d267d7691821/668be168923cee0d.webp) ### 로그 함수: ln(target) = log(target) ( 밑: e, 자연상수 ) ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT ln(7.3890560989306502272304274605750078132) # 결과: 2 log(7.3890560989306502272304274605750078132) # 결과: 2 FROM dual ``` - ln(7.38...) : \log_{e}(7.38...) = log_{e}(e^2) = 2 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80c0-a670-d267d7691821/490dfb1748945d20.webp)
